ablation_conclusion: Removing grid yielded the lowest AP difference (-0.0174) relative to full logistic regression. Groups whose removal improved AP: standings, context. Correlation, regularization and sampling affect these descriptive comparisons.
preprocessing_conclusion: Scaling before imputation changed validation AP by +0.0002. Impute → scale → clip changed AP by +0.0010 versus clip → impute → scale. For qualifying_gap_pct (1987 training missing values), the maximum absolute A1/A0 transformed-value difference was 10.2573. All 13 binary/indicator columns were preserved in both clipping orders. The primary comparison retained impute → scale.
coverage_sensitivity_conclusion: Training logistic regression on 2003-2018 instead of 1994-2018 changed validation AP by +0.0018, with the same estimator configuration and validation rows. Qualifying-position missingness changed from 19.0% to 0.3%. Sample size and era change too; this does not isolate the effect of qualifying coverage. Primary training remains 1994-2018.
xai_conclusion: Leading permutation features: grid, qualifying_position, driver_prior_starts. Leading mean absolute SHAP features: grid, qualifying_position, driver_form_podium_rate. SHAP units: podium probability (Kernel SHAP approximation); global validation sample size 60, stratified in proportion to season counts (2019: 21, 2020: 17, 2021: 22). Sampling uses no outcomes. A separately appended local-only case is excluded from global averages and beeswarm plots. Correlated inputs can share or substitute information; independent perturbations may form unrealistic combinations. None of these measures establishes causality.
local_explanation: Same local case for both explainers: validation raceId=1027, driverId=830; probability=0.497, actual podium=0, threshold=0.347. Positive SHAP contributors: qualifying_position, grid; negative contributors: round, year. Reconstruction=0.497 (absolute error 0.000000); LIME local surrogate R²=0.399. SHAP displays scaled values; LIME displays imputed original-unit values and binary flags, with frozen scaling inside its prediction wrapper. The local surrogate explains about 39.9% of the weighted variation in its sampled neighborhood. Substantial unexplained variation limits this LIME explanation; treat its feature weights as approximate.
inference_conclusion: Complete-record probability=0.595; partially missing=0.460, with 6 fields filled using training medians. Missing-grid probability=0.026; only grid is imputed and its flag derives as 1. Null/zero/negative grid agree; contradictory flags, unknown keys and nonfinite numbers are rejected. All three native reloaded models match the original predictions. Inputs are engineered pre-race features, not raw names or lookup queries.
limitations: One chronological validation period; repeated validation experiments can overfit; historical regulation/scoring/qualifying drift; no external probability calibration; independent binary calls need not produce exactly three podiums; absent weather, tyre and strategy inputs; observational importance and home association are not causal.
neural_implementation: Keras Sequential, one hidden ReLU layer, one sigmoid output; binary cross-entropy, Adam, exact validation-AP callback before EarlyStopping with best-weight restoration; native .keras persistence
